title: Homecoming and Scholarship
author: Silas Villalobos
blurb: Casper Hartwell, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must expose what the school board buried before graduation.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
